title: fix(fields): an html or richtext cell holding a heading keeps the list row one line high
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36452
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里富文本或 HTML 字段的值以标题开头时，这一行原来会被撑高，现在和其他行一样高、标题按单元格字号加粗显示;记录详情页和只读表单里的标题仍是原来的大字号。
- 这是上一张卡(列表里 Markdown 标题按单元格字号显示)的同类补齐，替所有在列表里看富文本字段的用户解决行高不齐。
- 出错的话，最坏是列表单元格里的标题显示成普通加粗文字或仍偏大，不影响数据和内容过滤安全，可直接撤回此改动。
- 无

## What changes

- `HtmlCellRenderer` (the `html` and `richtext` display pipeline) now reads `inGridColumn`. In a grid column it draws the sanitized tree in the same `cell` face the markdown cell got: every heading level is a `p.font-semibold` at the cell's own text size, and the body takes the cell's font size and line height. Outside a grid column (record page, readonly form field) nothing changes: heading elements and `prose-sm` sizes stay.
- One definition for both pipelines: the face classes and the heading element map move from `MarkdownContent.tsx` into `richTextDisplay.tsx` (`RICH_TEXT_DOCUMENT_CLASS`, `RICH_TEXT_CELL_FACE_CLASS`, `cellFaceHeadings(marker)`), and `MarkdownContent` imports them. They live in `richTextDisplay` rather than in `MarkdownContent` so the html cell does not pull the lazy react-markdown chunk into the eager bundle. None of these is exported from the package barrel.
- `renderSanitizedHtml(html, components?)` takes an optional element map handed to `toJsxRuntime`. It is applied after `rehype-sanitize` has run, so it changes how a kept element is drawn, never what is kept: the allow-list and the strip list are untouched.
- The html container now carries `data-html-face="cell|document"` (the markdown one already carried `data-markdown-face`); its `innerHTML` is unchanged in the document face, which the 8580 byte-for-byte pin confirms.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/markdownCellHeading-36344.test.tsx` (the cell-heading face harness, new top-level describe): html and richtext in a grid column draw no heading element, the heading is `P.font-semibold` with `data-html-heading`, the face carries `text-[length:inherit] leading-[inherit]`, the script in the value is still stripped; all six levels map; the html and markdown cells produce the same heading tag and class and the same face class; CONTROL for html and richtext outside a grid column keeps the `h1` and the document classes.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.richTextOneLine-12480.test.tsx` (the grid's rich-text one-line harness, new top-level describe): through `ObjectGrid`, html and richtext cells whose value starts with a heading draw the cell face and `tbody` holds no `h1`..`h6`.
- Existing test changed because of this fix: in the same 12480 file, the case "10 rows with a markdown, an html and a richtext column" asserted the html cell inside the clamp holds an `h2`; it now asserts the heading is drawn as `[data-html-heading]` reading `Title`. This is the behaviour the card asks to change. No other existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the dispatch named `fields/src/**/__tests__/` for tests. The 12480 file under `plugin-grid` was outside it and had to change, because one of its assertions pinned the old heading element in a grid cell. The grid-level pin for this card went into that same file as a top-level describe, per the shared-harness rule.
- Not changed, noted: the doc comment on `CellRendererProps.inGridColumn` in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` still says the prop is read by the `date` and `markdown` cells; the `html` / `richtext` cell now reads it too. That file is outside this card's file surface, so the comment is left for the seat to route.
- jsdom has no layout. The pins check the elements and classes that the row height depends on. The pixel readings are below.

## Verification

Read these first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/sanitizedHtml.tsx`: the `components` option on `toJsxRuntime`. This is the sanitizer module, so check that the map is applied after sanitisation and the schema is untouched.
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx`: `HtmlCellRenderer` and `cellFaceHeadings`.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/MarkdownContent.tsx`: now imports the shared face.

Two-minute check: open any object list whose `html` or `richtext` field holds a value starting with a heading. The row should be as tall as its neighbours, with the heading in bold at the cell's text size. Open the record: the heading should be full size.

<details><summary>Measurement (card item 1): through ObjectGrid, before and after</summary>

Method: four rows rendered through `ObjectGrid` in jsdom: html holding an h1 heading plus a paragraph, richtext holding the same, markdown starting with a heading, and a plain row. The resulting table markup was then laid out in Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, 1200 px wide) with the console stylesheet compiled from `ui/apps/console/src/index.css` (Tailwind 4 plus typography).

Before (origin/main 87c7bbaf): `tbody` holds an `H1` in the html row and in the richtext row. Row heights: html 45 px, richtext 45 px, markdown 36 px, plain 36 px. The heading is drawn at font-size 30px, line-height 36px.

After (4f80ba10): `tbody` holds no heading element. Row heights: 36 / 36 / 36 / 36 px. The heading is a `P` at font-size 14px, line-height 17.5px, the same as the markdown cell's heading.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the tested behaviour)</summary>

Mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: in `HtmlCellRenderer`, the line that picks `cell` when `inGridColumn` is set was changed to always pick `document` (anchor 1 → 0, blob baccb823 → 9b850e05). Run: the 36344 and 12480 files. Result: 6 failed, 8 passed. The failures were the four html/richtext grid-column cases in the fields harness, the updated 12480 assertion, and the new grid pin. The controls stayed green: the markdown cases and the html/richtext document-face cases. After restore the blob equals HEAD (baccb823) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (head 1b5c106b, after merging origin/main)</summary>

- Dependency closure `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid^...`: 53/53 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check`: exit 0 (both test tsconfigs list the changed test files).
- `vitest run packages/fields/` plus the 12480 file: Test Files 323 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 4896 passed, 7 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Before the merge, at 4f80ba10: `vitest run packages/fields/ packages/plugin-grid/`: Test Files 629 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 7604 passed, 7 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at 1b5c106b: 38 families, each run, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `ui` `check:spec-symbols` exit 0; `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
